title: Leaving school after a fight with Rocko
summary: He practiced guitar after school, never went to high school and was put out for fighting an Italian boy named Rocko.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I was going to school, but I mean in the afternoons, when I'd come home, I'd get on that guitar. And everything I'd hear I'd play, try to play.
Before I finished I was playing it. Give me another cigarette.
Did you go into high school?
No? You just kept -- you just went -- when did you leave school?
I left school -- I got put out of school.
Yeah. I was a youngster, you know. Fighting. I had a fight with an Italian boy who used to try to whip me and take my marbles. Rocko.
Seems like there's a Rocko in every school.
How about that. Well, you can't blame them. After all, it's a free country, so they claim.
